content: To summarise, our results demonstrate that the best white-box methods (e.g. HotFlip) may not produce adversarial examples that generalise to fooling other classifiers. We also saw that convolutional networks are more vulnerable than recurrent networks, and that dataset features such as text lengths and training data size (for target classifiers) can influence how difficult it is to perform adversarial attack.
